The unit appears to be a 2WD automatic transmission, as suggested by the seller.

risks.risk: The transmission may not be from a 2005 Toyota Sienna, or may be from a different model/year.

risks.risk: The transmission may have internal damage or fluid leaks not visible from the outside.

A close-up photo of the front of the transmission showing any model or part numbers.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
